title: Fixed connectors and cable budgets
description: A 200x120x50mm enclosure has two connectors already mounted on the walls and they must stay exactly where they are: usb_conn (20x15x10mm) at [0,50,0] and pwr_conn (20x15x10mm) at [180,10,0]. Place mcu (50x50x15mm) and battery (100x60x20mm). The USB ribbon is short: the surface gap between usb_conn and mcu must be at most 30mm. The power lead is shorter: the gap between pwr_conn and battery must be at most 20mm. The battery must keep at least 10mm clearance from the mcu. No overlaps, no rotation, everything inside. Return the min-corner [x,y,z] of all four components in millimeters, including the fixed connectors at their given positions.
